title: Timeless 30A | KEY.co
description_expanded: Timeless 30A is a showstopping coastal retreat where contemporary design meets laid-back luxury, steps from the sugar-white sands of the iconic 30A coastline. This expansive, professionally designed getaway offers the ideal blend of comfort and sophistication across three spacious levels, with nine elegant bedrooms including two bunk rooms and multiple gathering spaces that cater to every kind of traveler. Whether enjoying a game of pool in the ground-level game room, relaxing in one of the private king suites, or gathering in the chef’s kitchen with its top-of-the-line Wolf appliances, every corner of the home is crafted for connection, relaxation, and unforgettable moments. The outdoor spaces are equally captivating. Plush loungers and shaded umbrellas surround a private pool and spa, while a cozy firepit invites evening conversation under the stars. Enjoy al fresco dining from the second-floor summer kitchen or explore the tranquil waters of Allen Lake from your private dock. Kids and adults alike will love the media and game rooms, complete with foosball and arcade games. With high-end finishes, thoughtful amenities, and a walkable location near beloved local spots like Stinky’s Fish Camp, Timeless 30A is more than a vacation home; it’s a destination for making lasting memories in one of Florida’s most coveted beach communities.
